_about: Verxina (1090/109001). UmaTL hachimi-tl-en where it has her rows ('horsegirl' -> Umamusume); the rest translated in Global's style. Voice lines still Japanese.

text_data.144:1090: Deserving of the queen's throne. A celebrity Umamusume with unyielding spirit.
text_data.163:1090: I am Verxina. I won't give up until I break down everything in my path to become a queen.
